channel.title: ASI Law: Sovereign of the Chaos Sea
channel.description: An original web novel by czverse.

item.title: Chapter 182: You Didn't Ask Us
item.description: "Mister Zhou," said Chair Adaeze Okafor. "The last time you moved eleven thousand people, I asked you to ask the Council first. I said we'd have said yes. I said we'd have liked to be asked."

item.title: Chapter 181: The Few Who Stayed
item.description: Afterward, in the field, with the silk of two dead walkers lying across the pale ground in long glittering drifts, Major Zhuo Wenli opened his eyes.

item.title: Chapter 180: Where the Threads Are Tied
item.description: Seed said it fast, the way it said things when it had seen something all at once and was afraid of losing it.

item.title: Chapter 179: Above the Sky
item.description: The keeper came for them at three in the morning, the way it always came, and this time it did not send a thread. It sent a road.

item.title: Chapter 178: Weight With an Opinion
item.description: On the first day, Lingyue could not hold a pebble.

item.title: Chapter 177: Three Lamps
item.description: "The head is the lamp," said Seed. "That is what we learned in the round chamber. That is the only thing we know for certain about anything that walks down from above the sky."

item.title: Chapter 176: The Keeper Asks
item.description: The keeper asked him on a Thursday, at four in the afternoon, which was the first thing that was wrong, because the keeper always came at three in the morning, the long way, through the Elder.

item.title: Chapter 175: The Night Bell
item.description: Ren played it to the monks at dusk, kneeling on the step under the six hundred and twelfth gate with a satellite phone held against the worn stone and her other hand flat beside it.

item.title: Chapter 174: The Shallows
item.description: The rift under the old tram depot opened at 02:16 on a Tuesday, and by 02:19 it was over, and that was the first time Yuanshu understood what being a Lord meant.

item.title: Chapter 173: Something It Is Afraid Of
item.description: Seed wrote the question down before it asked it.

item.title: Chapter 172: Nine Seconds, Twenty-Two Seconds
item.description: "It's getting longer," said Xiaoyu. "Every month. Nobody's said anything about that."

item.title: Chapter 171: Inside, Again
item.description: The board in the Ossuary was longer than when he had left.

item.title: Chapter 170: Twelve Hundred and Three
item.description: Sister Ning came on the third day, with forty people from the Quiet, and a great many blankets.

item.title: Chapter 169: Watch It Back
item.description: It asked them all at once.

item.title: Chapter 168: The Dark of the Moon
item.description: At eleven at night on the fourth night, the Abbot got up off the step for the first time in seven days, and slid open the door of the hall, and stood aside.

item.title: Chapter 167: Under the Gates
item.description: "There are more of them," said Shirasagi Ren. "I never told you. I never told anyone."

item.title: Chapter 166: The Lowest Terrace
item.description: She sat there all night, and nobody asked her anything until dawn.

item.title: Chapter 165: The Lens
item.description: They did the work in the kitchen of the shrine, because it was the only room on the mountain with a stove, and because Ren said the Abbot had never once in forty years set foot in it, and she did not…

item.title: Chapter 164: Twelve Hundred and Two
item.description: Yamato came up out of the sea at dawn, green, the way it had the first time, and Lingyue was waiting on the jetty with her arms folded.

item.title: Chapter 163: Off Watch
item.description: The stars went out in the north first, and then in the east, and then all of them, until the sky over the Adeyemi was a single black lid from horizon to horizon, and the sea under it was black, and…
